parameters.description:
Ground truth (correct) target values. Sparse matrix is only supported when
labels are of :term:`multilabel` type.
parameters.name: y_true
parameters.type_doc: {array-like, sparse matrix} of shape (n_samples, n_outputs) or (n_samples,)

parameters.description:
Estimated targets as returned by a classifier. Sparse matrix is only
supported when labels are of :term:`multilabel` type.
parameters.name: y_pred
parameters.type_doc: {array-like, sparse matrix} of shape (n_samples, n_outputs) or (n_samples,)

parameters.description:
A list of classes or column indices to select some (or to force
inclusion of classes absent from the data).
parameters.name: labels

parameters.description: In the multilabel case, this calculates a confusion matrix per sample.
parameters.name: samplewise

returns.description:
A 2x2 confusion matrix corresponding to each output in the input.
When calculating class-wise multi_confusion (default), then
n_outputs = n_labels; when calculating sample-wise multi_confusion
(samplewise=True), n_outputs = n_samples. If ``labels`` is defined,
the results will be returned in the order specified in ``labels``,
otherwise the results will be returned in sorted order by default.
returns.name: multi_confusion

summary: Compute a confusion matrix for each class or sample.
